sources.title: RFC 9457 — Problem Details for HTTP APIs

coverage.taughtAt: Three V3 objectives: response oracle, wire matrix and mutation-based schema/error checks
coverage.assessedAt: Ten HTTP exchanges, three negative mutations, five self-check questions and contract-gap declaration
coverage.evidenceExpected: 200/201/400/401/403/404/409/500 observed on local stub; 422 not declared; response Content-Type, required fields, headers and Problem status correct.
